name: (EARLY HALLOWEEN UPD ) Chaotic Cluster
desc:
(LEGACY VERSION- THIS GAME WILL NOT GET ANYMORE UPDATES WORKING ON A REMAKE)

Have you ever wanted to wage war against 16 people in a small floating island with a tiny variety of weapons? No? Are you sure? Yes? Really? I think you would enjoy it? Still no? Well, I can't force you.
Props to Mog_tehcat and Oofyourselfnow1 for giving me nearly all of the ideas.
Inspired by Forsaken, Block Tales and Roblox as a whole!
Art by Oofyourselfnow1 and Doomsafari.

WARNING: This game is guaranteed to cause lag so if you're on mobile your phone will probably explode. also allotaaaa free models.
